Omar Abdullah Warns On Kashmiri Pandit Security

Omar Abdullah warned against taking terror threats to Kashmiri Pandit employees lightly. He emphasized the importance of not overlooking the security of Kashmiri Pandits in the Valley. The warning comes amid concerns over the safety of Kashmiri Pandit employees in the region. Omar Abdullah stressed that their security must not be taken lightly. The issue of Kashmiri Pandit security has been a significant concern in recent times. Omar Abdullah's statement highlights the need for attention to this matter.
